topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The package came in a quiet moment, a soft knock of surprise against the day’s stillness. The label spoke of someone else, an echo of the house before it held my breath and dreams. I traced the name with a finger, a gentle spell to uncover stories not mine, yet somehow belonging to this place now. Opening it, the contents whispered secrets of a life lived here, a tapestry of moments now mingling with my own. I set the items aside, each a gift not meant for me, yet cradled with the care one might offer a letter from a friend yet to meet. The space around me seemed to soften, the walls themselves seeming to hold a smile, as if they too were pleased with this quiet, fortuitous intersection of strangers and stories.
